endorsements.name: Joern Schneeweisz
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-1485
endorsements.description: A flaw was found in the decompression function of registry-support. This issue can be triggered if an unauthenticated remote attacker tricks a user into parsing a devfile which uses the `parent` or `plugin` keywords. This could download a malicious archive and cause the cleanup process to overwrite or delete files outside of the archive, which should not be allowed.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8)
